name: magentic-stack
description: Runs the CPCP seams. One Rails image under many ROLEs, plus MIND (Python), SwitchYard (Rust upstream behind a Node front) and oxigraph.

contract.note: Scope vocabulary and the method-to-scope map come from spec/scopes.md at this revision. Adding a scope to a seam is a contract change there first. Referenced by repo and revision, not by path: ADR 0020 keeps gems/adapters/ the only code that reaches the vendored tree, and the pin records live in the manifests.

vocabulary.public_cpcp: No credentials, no real data. Replay-safe to observe. Not served from this repo; the reference surface is cpcp_demo.
vocabulary.pod_internal_cpcp: Pod-network traffic between containers. Unpublished (expose, never ports). Callers allowlisted per seam, Bearer tokens, fail-closed boot on empty allowlists.
vocabulary.pod_external_cpcp: Host-published loopback for operators, editors and browsers. Reachable from the host, never the open internet. Publishing a port never widens what the seam admits.

seams.note: Only declared domain writer with BACKJOB (ADR 0056). pod_external only in the extract profile, where back publishes 13002.
Read-back asymmetry: config-admin may put/list, never get.
Async projection of metadata derived from BACK journal. No production caller yet.
Next-boot placement intentions against the closed path set. config-admin caller.
Python stdlib seam. Conformance and debug callers.

UNDECLARED. This seam is live here but does not appear in the contract method-to-scope map. It is browser-local credential routing (switchyard.route, cpcp.ready, cid), not pod-network traffic, so none of the three scopes is obviously right. Needs a contract decision, not a guess here.

exposure.note: Measured from the compose files, not asserted. pod_internal is expose-only; a published port is what makes a surface pod_external.

not_a_seam.front: route-gated off /_cpcp (ADR 0047 amendment 2). Publishes a page, admits nothing.
not_a_seam.runtimes/switch: OpenAI-compatible completions, no /_cpcp. Node today, target Rust.
not_a_seam.shape: GET-only retrieval, not a POST-rpc seam.
